pattern_application_methods.description: Applies a PatternSet to the grid by matching categories
Applies a FlexiblePatternSet which clears all rows and creates new ones

pattern_application_methods.signature: void setCell(int row, int step, bool on, bool repaintNow = true)

current_flow: 1. User right-clicks on loop tile in SampleBrowserPage
2. Context menu shows 'Learn Pattern from Audio' (item 400)
5. MultiBandPatternExtractor analyzes audio and extracts patterns
6. PatternPreviewDialog shown for user to review/edit patterns
7. On 'Save Patterns' click, patterns saved to UserPatternDatabase ONLY
8. StepSequencer is NOT updated with the learned pattern
summary.gap_identified: The PatternPreviewDialog callback at lines 6844-6906 saves patterns to database but does NOT inject them into the stepSequencer_. The SampleBrowserPage has direct access to stepSequencer_ (member variable), and StepSequencerComponent has applyPatternSet() method that could be called to inject the learned pattern.
key_integration_points: Need to convert PatternPreviewDialog::Result to PatternSet format
